results.title: How much does Pipedrive cost in 2026? — Method
results.content:
Pipedrive’s tiered plans are fairly easy to follow. Each tier adds more tools and flexibility, so you can choose what matches your team’s size and sales process.

Here are Pipedrive’s four main pricing tiers:

|  |  |  |
 --- 
| Plan | Annual billing | Monthly billing |
| Lite | $14/seat/month | $24/seat/month |
| Growth | $39/seat/month | $49/seat/month |
| Premium | $49/seat/month | $79/seat/month |
| Ultimate | $79/seat/month | $99/seat/month | [...] No credit card is required, and the trial provides you with the full advanced plan. This way, you can test Pipedrive and its best features before making a decision.

## What you get in each plan

From basic deal tracking in “Lite” to advanced security and testing options in “Ultimate,” the tiers are designed to match different stages of your sales process. Here’s a closer look at what you get in each plan.

### Lite plan

💲 Cost: $14/seat/month (annual), $24/seat/month (monthly) [...] | Projects 🗂️ | Starting from $6.67/user/month | Project management with kanban view, tasks, subtasks, labels, custom fields |
| Smart Docs 💻 | Starting from $32.50/month per company (free for higher tier plans) | Trackable quotes, proposals, contracts, e-signatures, AI alerts, auto-fill |
